excerpts: ADD TIME ON GOOGLE by Justin Worland Open follow modal Senior Correspondent by Justin Worland Open follow modal Senior Correspondent Social media success runs in the blood of the Jenner-Kardashian clan with Kim Kardashian leading the pack. But Kendall Jenner may have usurped at least one title. She now has the most-liked Instagram photo of all time. A photo of an elegantly dressed Kendall Jenner lying on the ground with her hair in heart shapes is now the most-liked photo on the social network. The photo of the 19-year-old model racked up 2.5 million likes in five weeks. The previous record was held by Kim Kardashian whose wedding photo with Kanye West from last year has 2.4 million likes. results.title: An egg has overtaken Kylie Jenner as most-liked Instagram post ever
excerpts:
A picture of an egg has become the most-liked post in Instagram history.
The record had previously been held by reality TV star Kylie Jenner. A photograph of an egg has overtaken Kylie Jenner as the holder of the most-liked post ever on Instagram. The picture – from account @world_record_egg – currently has almost 25 million likes, beating Jenner's record 18 million likes on a post announcing the birth of her daughter Stormi last year. "Let's set a world record together and get the most like post on Instagram," the post read.
